verdict.rationale: Treasury has no documented user-configurable automation feature such as scheduled transfers, sweeps, or rules. It does expose an API for money movement (outbound payments, funding financial accounts) and event notifications like v2.money_management.transaction.created, so a developer could build background, event-driven automations with custom code. Platforms can also build and operate their own controls over money movement. Missing for 10: native scheduled or rule-based automations, no-code automation setup, documentation of autonomous background workflows, and hands-on corroboration.
